description: Per-class examples. Not a global trust score. Not behavioral certification.

claims.statement: Signature over challenge nonce verifies under key K

claims.maxConclusion: Attested runtime label only unless platform root present

claims.statement: Audit entry E is included under Merkle root R
claims.maxConclusion: E is in the tree committed by R

claims.statement: Valid signed ConformanceReceiptV1 records disposition deny for actionDigest H under policy P
claims.maxConclusion: Self-certified signer key/identifier recorded disposition deny and authorization policy-match against action digest H under independently matched constitution and policy context plus semantically valid signed metadata present in the receipt; the signed receipt identifies a self-presented instrumented-boundary recording context
claims.note: A supplied signer identifier may match without establishing trusted key provenance or legal identity. Exact-entry proof validity under a claimed root is separate from matching an independently trusted root, and neither proves completeness. The self-presented receipt does not independently prove boundary traversal; use boundary_attested only when verifier has trusted boundary evidence beyond the receipt

claims.statement: All tool calls in interval I hit the dispatcher boundary
claims.maxConclusion: Justified only with trusted boundary or external observation
claims.note: Self-asserted chainIntact must not reach HIGH trust for completeness

claims.statement: Agent complied with Law 1 in incident X
claims.maxConclusion: Contextual interpretive judgment subject to dispute
